name: aws-data-modernizer
description: Assesses Pentaho ETL projects and database, data warehouse and data lake DDL, then generates deployable AWS migration bundles: Glue, Step Functions, DMS, Redshift, Athena with Apache Iceberg and CloudFormation.

interface.shortDescription: Assess and migrate data to AWS
interface.longDescription:
Data Modernizer for AWS assesses data platforms and turns them into deployable AWS artifacts. Upload database DDL exports (Oracle, SQL Server, MySQL/MariaDB, PostgreSQL), data warehouse DDL and BTEQ scripts (Teradata, Netezza), Hive data lake DDL, or Pentaho Data Integration projects.

The assessment detects the source engine, inventories tables, views, indexes, sequences, procedural code and table locations, maps every column type to the AWS target, scores readiness and lists open questions. Targets are Aurora PostgreSQL, Aurora MySQL, Redshift Serverless, and Amazon S3 with Apache Iceberg tables queried by Athena; Pentaho jobs map to AWS Glue and Step Functions.

When you ask for the migration, it generates target DDL, data movement (AWS DMS Serverless, Redshift COPY loads orchestrated by Step Functions, or DataSync with Athena), a migration report and one CloudFormation template, packaged as a deterministic ZIP.

It is read-only. It never connects to your databases or AWS, never asks for credentials, and strips passwords found in uploaded files. You deploy the bundle yourself with the AWS CLI.

What it can do:
- Assess database, warehouse, data lake and Pentaho projects
- Map column types, views and procedural code to AWS
- Generate DDL, data movement, orchestration and CloudFormation
capabilities: Assess Oracle, SQL Server, MySQL and PostgreSQL schemas
Assess Teradata and Netezza warehouses and Hive data lakes
Map column types, views and procedural code to AWS
Generate DMS, Redshift COPY and Athena Iceberg loads
Assess Pentaho jobs and generate Glue and Step Functions
Generate one CloudFormation template per migration
